$25 off your order of $250+*. Code BOO25
Your Head Start on the Holidays

Holiday shipping is on us when you're a StewardShip member, and there are three ways to get it this season:

  • Spend $300 from our select list and get a free 90-day StewardShip trial.
  • Spend $500 sitewide and get a full year of StewardShip.
  • Join today for $69/year, no purchase required.

StewardShip means free standard shipping on eligible orders, whether the box is coming to your door or going out as a gift. Members also get deals and discounts, a members-only list of wines, and an early look at our holiday selections, including the Wine.com 100 Top 5 before anyone else.
